title: Weighted Adjoint Matching: Finetuning Flow Matching Models with Time-Dependent Control Cost
abstract: arXiv:2610.20035v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Weighted Adjoint Matching, a method to finetune a pretrained diffusion or flow matching model given a differentiable reward. We derive it from Adjoint Matching, which reformulates finetuning as a stochastic optimal control problem with a quadratic control cost. Building on the observation that these models generate coarse features before fine details, we place a time-dependent weight on the control cost. A high cost early in the generative process preserves balance and diversity in the coarse features, which carry most of the semantics, while a low cost at the end lets the model increase the reward by refining details. We prove that our method is equivalent to maximizing the reward under time-varying Kullback--Leibler regularization on the generative paths. Experiments on Gaussian mixtures and on MNIST show a better tradeoff between reward and mode balance than Adjoint Matching.

translated_title: 加权伴随匹配：使用时间依赖控制代价微调流匹配模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了加权伴随匹配，这是一种在给定可微奖励的情况下微调预训练扩散模型或流匹配模型的方法。该方法源自伴随匹配，后者将微调重新表述为具有二次控制代价的随机最优控制问题。基于这些模型先生成粗略特征、后生成精细细节的观察，我们在控制代价上引入了时间依赖的权重。在生成过程早期施加高代价可以保持携带大部分语义信息的粗略特征的平衡性与多样性，而在最后阶段施加低代价则允许模型通过细化细节来提高奖励。我们证明了该方法等价于在生成路径上施加时变KL散度正则化条件下最大化奖励。在高斯混合分布和MNIST数据集上的实验表明，与伴随匹配相比，我们的方法在奖励和模式平衡之间实现了更好的权衡。
tldr: 提出加权伴随匹配方法，通过在控制代价上引入时间依赖权重，早期保持粗略语义特征的多样性与平衡、后期精细化细节以提升奖励，从而在微调流匹配模型时实现奖励与模式平衡之间更好的权衡。
en_tdlr: Weighted Adjoint Matching finetunes flow matching models by applying a time-dependent weight to the control cost—high early to preserve diverse coarse semantic features and low late to allow detail refinement—achieving a better reward and mode balance tradeoff than Adjoint Matching.
